title: Let's Learn English Lesson 38
subtitle: She's My Best Friend!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 38: She's My Best Friend! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! I have great news. My best friend from my hometown is coming here -- to Washington, D.C.! I can't wait to catch up with her! Oh! I gotta go. Her train arrives in 10 minutes!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我有好消息。我家乡最好的朋友要来这儿——华盛顿特区！我等不及要跟她叙旧了！哦！我得走了。她的火车 10 分钟后到！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope!
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna! I am really happy to see you!
dialogue.zh: 安娜！见到你真开心！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Me too! How was your trip?
dialogue.zh: 我也是！旅途怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: It was fine.
dialogue.zh: 还不错。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let me help you with your bags.
dialogue.zh: 我来帮你拿行李。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: I'm really excited to be in Washington, D.C.! I can't wait to hear about ... everything!
dialogue.zh: 来到华盛顿特区我真的很兴奋！我等不及想听……所有的事！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have so much to tell you. Let's go to my apartment. We can talk over a hot cup of tea.
dialogue.zh: 我有好多话要跟你说。我们去我的公寓。可以边喝茶边聊。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: I love your apartment building, Anna. Is your rent expensive?
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢你的公寓楼，安娜。房租贵吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I have a roommate. So, we split the rent.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我有室友。所以我们平分房租。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Oh, that's right. Is your roommate nice?
dialogue.zh: 哦，对。你的室友人好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha is the nicest person I know in this city. Sometimes she worries too much. And she says I'm the messiest cook she knows. But we are great roommates.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎是我在这座城市认识的最好的人。有时她担心太多。她还说我是她认识的最乱的厨师。不过我们是很好的室友。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: So, Anna, is it hard to make friends in D.C.?
dialogue.zh: 那么，安娜，在华盛顿特区交朋友难吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: At first it was hard. But now, Marsha is a good friend. And there's Pete. Of all the people I know in D.C., Pete is the most serious and also the silliest.
dialogue.zh: 一开始很难。但现在，玛莎是好朋友。还有皮特。在我认识的华盛顿特区的人里，皮特最认真，也最傻。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: He sounds ... interesting.
dialogue.zh: 他听起来……挺有意思。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Jonathan and Ashley are two other good friends of mine. In the city, they are the friendliest people I know. They always help me when I need it.
dialogue.zh: 乔纳森和阿什莉是我另外两个好朋友。在这座城市，他们是我认识的最友好的人。我需要时他们总是帮我。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Your friends sound great! So, tell me about your job.
dialogue.zh: 你的朋友听起来很棒！那么，跟我说说你的工作。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love my work! I make a children's show called the "Time Traveling Treehouse."
dialogue.zh: 我爱我的工作！我做了一个儿童节目，叫“时光旅行树屋”。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna, that is the best job for you! Do you remember when we were little? We played in that old treehouse behind my family's house for hours!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，那最适合你！你还记得我们小时候吗？我们在我家后面那座旧树屋里玩好几个小时！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I forgot about that! We thought it really time traveled! It is really good to talk to you. New friends are good. But old friends are the best.
dialogue.zh: 我都忘了！我们以为它真的会时光旅行！跟你聊天真好。新朋友很好。但老朋友最好。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: I know. Our hometown isn't the same now. You are not there.
dialogue.zh: 我知道。我们的家乡现在不一样了。你不在那儿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No crying. No crying. Penelope, why don't you move here and live with me and Marsha?
dialogue.zh: 别哭。别哭。佩内洛普，你为什么不搬来这儿，跟我和玛莎一起住？

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna, I can't leave our hometown. You forget -- I love my job, too.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我不能离开家乡。你忘了——我也爱我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I didn't forget. You are the most famous turkey farmer I know!
dialogue.zh: 我没忘。你是我认识的最有名的火鸡农场主！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Thanks, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Come on. Let's go eat dinner at one of D.C.'s most famous restaurants.
dialogue.zh: 来吧。我们去华盛顿特区最有名的餐厅之一吃晚饭。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Awesome!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have a great apartment. I love my work. And I have awesome friends. I am the luckiest woman in Washington, D.C.
dialogue.zh: 我有很棒的公寓。我爱我的工作。我还有很棒的朋友。我是华盛顿特区最幸运的女人。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time?
dialogue.zh: 下次见？

quiz.prompt: Who is visiting Anna from her hometown?
What children's show does Anna make?
